draft_evidence.quote: he caught the stone-grey light lying faint along her forearms, less a glow than a change in what her skin was willing to be.

comparison_evidence.quote: Any new specific description of the stone-grey forearm light beyond 'faint, visible only if looking for it'

findings.consequence: The added skin-property image exceeds the packet's pre-approved description and may imply an unapproved Stone Path manifestation detail, creating avoidable canon drift in later depictions.
findings.repair_target: Remove or neutralize 'less a glow than a change in what her skin was willing to be' so the description conveys only faintness and visibility to an attentive observer, or obtain an explicit human exception for the added image.

concerns: Draft line 111 says 'the first win of his life,' while the packet establishes the narrower fact 'first circuit win.' No supplied evidence proves a contradiction, but the broader literal scope merits confirmation before publication.

The spending/account/currency image is coherent with Cael's tactical thinking but recurs densely across lines 15-39; whether that repetition strengthens the governing metaphor or becomes conspicuous in audio is a line-level taste judgment.
strengths: The four-exchange architecture is unusually clear: every reset changes information, and the third-exchange earned tactic remains sharply separated from the fourth-exchange mystery.
Cael's competence has receipts—two watched bouts, a specific tell, disciplined refusal of the obvious follow-up, and a logged causal analysis—so the first win advances both skill and self-concept.
Dessa remains formidable and professionally generous in defeat; her forward advance is an adaptive tactical surprise rather than a personality break.
The unexplained movement pays off Ch9 without leaking the Wind connection or Book 3 integration SECRET, and the failed attempt to reproduce it protects non-summonability.

The Cael/Lira ending converts exposition into relationship movement: Lira offers a tentative word, accepts uncertainty, and receives an unprompted promise that splices cleanly into the supplied following seam.
Vell's spoken result plus silent precision note gives the win institutional and social consequence while remaining fully intelligible in audio.
